source_text.body:
Compare products with shopping agents despite checkout blocks
Shopping agents handled product comparison but often failed at checkout due to bot defenses and captchas; Claude on the user's own machine was blocked less often.
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
A San Francisco tech worker, Maia B, tried AI shopping agents on retail sites. Agents handled product comparison, but checkout hit bot checks and fraud review. She found Claude running on her own machine was blocked less often. The reason she gave was that it uses her IP address and doesn't look like an agent.
How it went
Sephora's bot check stopped the agent. An AutoZone order was cancelled after about 17 hours of fraud review. A Buck Mason purchase went through. Food delivery apps also threw errors.
Worth knowing
Guest checkout, a one-time virtual card and mismatched names together triggered AutoZone's fraud cancellation. The source is an anecdotal X thread, not a systematic test.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Compare [product type] options from [two or three retailers] for me, using my budget of [amount] and must-haves of [features]. Give me a ranked shortlist with price, shipping and reviews, then add my top pick to the cart. If a captcha or bot check blocks you, stop and tell me so I can finish it, and do not pay or submit the order without showing me the cart first.
Original source: https://i10x.ai/news/ai-shopping-agents-agentic-commerce-reality-check
